how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-hillsbrad-foothills-02-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:544:obj:0: Find the traitors and recover their artifacts, then return to Magus Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:544:details:0: I came to Tarren Mill to research, but now must resolve a crisis. You see, four ⟦E1⟧ fled the ⟦E2⟧ a few months ago. They turned their backs on their brethren, but what's worse...they stole from the Dark Lady.
rows.quest:544:details:1: These thieves broke into a secure vault and stole four artifacts, items our apothecaries required in certain studies. Sylvanas would have these artifacts returned.
rows.quest:544:details:2: The thieves fled the ⟦E2⟧ to ⟦E3⟧, and those wizards quarantined them in the Lordamere Internment Camp.
rows.quest:544:progress:0: Did you find the thieves?  And more importantly, did you find what they stole?
rows.quest:544:completion:0: You have done a great service for the ⟦E1⟧, ⟦1⟧. These artifacts have been sorely missed.
rows.quest:544:completion:1: And it is good to hear that Kegan and the other betrayers have found justice.
rows.quest:552:obj:0: Retrieve ⟦E4⟧ from the Yeti and bring it back to ⟦E5⟧ in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:552:details:0: Master Helcular was almost complete with his transformation into a Lich when a human lynch mob discovered his ritual lair in the hills and brutally killed him. To make matters worse they buried his corpse in the ⟦E6⟧ cemetery.
rows.quest:552:details:1: Such disregard for the great wizard is unacceptable. As his apprentice I shall see to it that the rains of vengeance fall upon the town of ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:552:details:2: We will need ⟦E4⟧ first. Yeti overtook his ritual lair. Undoubtedly one of the beasts has it.
rows.quest:552:progress:0: Have you recovered ⟦E4⟧ yet? There are so many Yeti in this region, it will be very difficult to locate. But we must have it in order to proceed.
rows.quest:553:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ the ⟦E8⟧ with the powers of the Flame of Azel, Flame of Veraz and the Flame of Uzel.
rows.quest:553:obj:1: Drive the charged rod into Helcular's grave in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:553:details:0: Here, take the ⟦E8⟧. You will need it.
rows.quest:553:details:1: Helcular fashioned 3 ceremonial pyres as part of his most powerful spell. The Flame of Azel and the Flame of Veraz lie within the Foothill Caverns. The Flame of Uzel lies in a cave above the caverns, further north in the mountains.
rows.quest:553:details:2: The ⟦E8⟧ must be charged from each of the three flames. Once the ritual is complete, drive the rod into Helcular's grave in ⟦E6⟧, the heavily guarded human town to the south. ⟦E10⟧ shall be ours!
rows.quest:553:progress:0: Helcular's grave teems with a mystical energy.
rows.quest:553:completion:0: A great rumbling emanates from the ground.
rows.quest:556:obj:0: Bring 10 Worn ⟦E11⟧ to ⟦E12⟧ in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:556:details:0: A notable talent of the wizards of ⟦E3⟧ is their familiarity with elementals: powerful creatures from other dimensions. The wizards use magical tokens as a means to control these elementals. Magus Voidglare would like some of these tokens to study.
rows.quest:556:details:1: Enter the territories of the ⟦E3⟧ wizards, west of Hillsbrad, and gather the tokens.
rows.quest:556:details:2: You might find the tokens on any citizen of ⟦E3⟧, but I suggest hunting at the internment camp. It's safer than ⟦E3⟧ itself.
rows.quest:556:progress:0: Do you have the Worn ⟦E11⟧, ⟦3⟧?  The Magus is eager to unlock their secrets.
rows.quest:556:completion:0: These will do nicely. Although it looks like their magic is faded, it would be best if the Magus' initial experiments were on inert specimens such as these.
rows.quest:659:obj:0: Find ⟦E14⟧ and ⟦E15⟧ near the Go'Shek Farm in the ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:659:details:0: Hail, and well met, ⟦5⟧. I lead a group of adventurers investigating odd happenings in this area.
rows.quest:659:details:1: My cousin in Hillsbrad recently put down his dog ⟦E17⟧ because the animal mystically grew to an immense size and savagely attacked anyone who came near him.
rows.quest:659:details:2: I believe the undead are involved, and we're looking for signs to prove as much.
rows.quest:659:details:3: Two of my companions, ⟦E14⟧ and ⟦E15⟧, headed to the Go'Shek Farm in the ⟦E16⟧, and haven't checked in for days. Find them for me? I grow concerned.
rows.quest:659:completion:0: Try and stay as quiet as possible, traveler.
rows.quest:659:completion:1: Orcs don't take too well to being spied on, and there is more to this farm than meets the eye.
rows.quest:93680:title: ⟦E20⟧
rows.quest:93680:obj:0: Acquire the ⟦E21⟧ for ⟦E22⟧ in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:93680:details:0: The ⟦E24⟧ had an army of mages known as the Kirin ⟦E25⟧. While they were powerful, the demonic ⟦E26⟧ proved to be even more so. In one fell swoop, the arch demon Archimonde flattened their city like it was a child's plaything. Those who remained were reduced to merely dispossessed vagabonds.
rows.quest:93680:details:1: That is, until they rebuilt ⟦E3⟧. And on the Dark Lady's very doorstep, no less!
rows.quest:93680:details:2: While in their camps, search for something that can get us into the city unnoticed. I must know more.
rows.quest:93680:progress:0: What have you found? An ancient tome? A secret relic?
rows.quest:96986:title: The Grave Knight
rows.quest:96986:obj:0: Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of ⟦E3⟧ for ⟦E28⟧ in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:96986:details:0: Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin ⟦E25⟧'s nose.
rows.quest:96986:details:1: I care not for the fate of the mage city, , but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we ⟦E1⟧ stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
rows.quest:533:obj:0: Retrieve information about ⟦E29⟧'s whereabouts for ⟦E30⟧ in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:533:details:0: At last we begin to hear word and rumor, find evidence of ⟦E29⟧'s whereabouts. The humans have been moving him around, but we are narrowing down our search and focusing on the large ⟦E31⟧ camp just north of here.
rows.quest:533:details:1: Go there, ⟦6⟧, and bring back whatever information you can get your hands on.
rows.quest:533:progress:0: Have you found anything? I fear ⟦E29⟧'s prospects grow worse by the day...
rows.quest:533:completion:0: Finally, we know where ⟦E29⟧ is being held. The camp in question is not too far from here, and hopefully they will not be as well prepared as they were when they captured us the first time.
rows.quest:557:details:0: The Magus will be busy studying those stone tokens you gathered, but I know he'll eventually want examples of their counterpart: bracers of binding. These are set around the wrists of actual elementals, and bind them into the mage's service.
rows.quest:557:details:1: Hunt elementals in the ruins of ⟦E3⟧ and gather their ⟦E33⟧, and the Magus will be pleased.
rows.quest:557:progress:0: Hello, ⟦7⟧. Elementals are tough quarry, but I know you're up to the task. Do you have those bracers of binding?
rows.quest:557:completion:0: You found them. I trust the elementals from which you removed these bracers were amenable?
rows.quest:557:completion:1: Hm...death has not only stopped my heart, but robbed me of my comedic timing, it seems.
rows.quest:557:completion:2: Well thank you, ⟦8⟧. You serve the Magus, and hence the Dark Lady, well.
rows.quest:564:obj:0: ⟦E34⟧ of ⟦E6⟧ wants you to kill 8 Mountain Lions and 10 Hulking Mountain Lions.
rows.quest:564:details:0: Ain't nothin' that irks me more than losin' these here beautiful horses. And believe me, we've lost quite a few between them pesky undead creeps, the dang ⟦E31⟧ gang and all the other good-for-nothin' scoundrels pokin' about these parts.
rows.quest:564:details:1: But I swear on my ol' grand-daddy's grave there ain't no bigger menace to our horses here than them Mountain Lions up in Alterac. Always comin' down from the hills and makin' my life difficult!
rows.quest:564:details:2: You fancy yourself a hero? Go and do somethin' about it then!
rows.quest:564:progress:0: Mountain Lions killin' off our horses left and right and here you are wantin' to jibber-jabber about the weather and what not.⟦9⟧⟦10⟧Ought to go and find myself a real hero. More killin' and less talkin'.
rows.quest:564:completion:0: Ain't that great news! Should-a gone and found me a regular ol' war hero from day one to take care of them beasts. You'd-a made your pappy proud, ⟦11⟧.
rows.quest:565:obj:0: Bring ⟦E35⟧ of ⟦E6⟧ a Bolt of Wool, a ⟦E36⟧, ⟦E37⟧ and 10 clumps of ⟦E38⟧.
rows.quest:565:details:0: I, the great Bartolo, shall make for you the world famous, ⟦E24⟧ renowned, ⟦E39⟧!
rows.quest:565:details:1: ⟦E40⟧ the planet and find yourself a better cloak, I dare you. Oh wait, what is that, little ⟦12⟧? "Bartolo, there is no finer cloak!" Yes, yes! That, I have heard before.
rows.quest:565:details:2: Bartolo requires a Bolt of Wool, a ⟦E36⟧ made by a skilled leatherworker, ⟦E37⟧ and ⟦E38⟧, of course! Bring to me these items and you shall be a happy customer!
rows.quest:565:progress:0: So you have returned to the great Bartolo. Perhaps you have finished gathering the materials needed for your ⟦E39⟧? Or maybe you just enjoy basking in the greatness of me, Bartolo!
rows.quest:565:completion:0: Now it is time for the great Bartolo to work his magic! I require no wizard's staff, no mage's rod. For I, the great Bartolo, work magic with a mere needle and thread!
rows.quest:545:obj:0: Kill 6 ⟦E3⟧ Summoners and 12 ⟦E42⟧ Slaves, then return to Magus Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:545:details:0: The wizards of ⟦E3⟧ constructed a vast, magical dome around the heart of their city. Some believe it was for protection from the violence of these times, while others say they merely wanted solitude, to study and plot.
rows.quest:545:details:1: I don't care what the reason was. I do care that the ruined outskirts of their city, outside the dome, may hide valuable magical treasures.
rows.quest:545:details:2: But the area is patrolled by the wizards and their elemental slaves.
rows.quest:545:details:3: So hunt them, and return when their numbers are sufficiently reduced.
rows.quest:545:progress:0: Have you yet thinned the ⟦E3⟧ patrols around their ruins?
rows.quest:545:completion:0: Very good. Those ruins should now be safe enough to search, if one is careful.
rows.quest:503:obj:0: Free ⟦E29⟧ then return to ⟦E30⟧ in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:503:details:0: From what I can tell of the documents you procured, ⟦E29⟧ is being held in a large ⟦E31⟧ base to the north, most likely in the ⟦E43⟧. He has been held captive far too long and must be freed.
rows.quest:503:progress:0: Give me the key, ⟦14⟧, I will undo the lock myself.
rows.quest:503:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦15⟧. I led the expedition from ⟦E44⟧ under the Warchief's orders, but as you can see, our plans went somewhat awry. They have held me captive here in this town, forcing me to work, hauling burdens, digging...
rows.quest:503:completion:1: What I have suffered is unimportant, however. There is important information you must deliver to whomever is leading our group now.
rows.quest:506:obj:0: Return the information gathered by ⟦E29⟧ to ⟦E30⟧ in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:506:details:0: A day or two ago, I was visited by the leader of this ⟦E31⟧. His name was Aliden Perenolde, and styled himself lord of this land. He confided in me his plans to take the orcs that stood against him as slaves, just as his father and his mentor, the despised Blackmoore, had planned.
rows.quest:506:details:1: More important was that he brought his mistress, a wisp of a girl named ⟦E45⟧. Around her neck was the pendant the Warchief desires.
rows.quest:506:details:2: Now go, I will make my own way, after I have settled my business here.
rows.quest:506:completion:0: The nerve of those overbearing humans! We'll show them that the orcs shall never submit to their will!
rows.quest:506:completion:1: This will now be our mission, in addition to recovering the trinket the Warchief desires. It would seem that by accomplishing one, we will also accomplish the other.
rows.quest:657:details:0: <⟦E14⟧ begins to go through the folder.>
rows.quest:657:details:1: This IS interesting. Seems Apothecary Jorell has been working on some deadly experiments here at Go'Shek. Not sure what that has to do with Hillsbrad, but Phin wouldn't like it if we let it continue.
rows.quest:657:details:2: We had a run-in with some orcs while you were gone, and I'm not in good enough shape to help ⟦E15⟧. If you're up for it, she's going to need some protection when she goes down to the farm to steal whatever research Jorell still hasn't sent to Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:657:completion:0: If it brings Phin peace, I'll destroy every single one of the ⟦E1⟧ personally. He's done so much for us since the plague. We never thought we'd find friends or family again.
rows.quest:657:completion:1: When you're prepared, come let me know. We'll get started right away.
rows.quest:658:obj:0: Find the ⟦E46⟧ and bring back her ⟦E47⟧ to ⟦E14⟧ near the Go'Shek Farm.
rows.quest:658:details:0: So, Phin sent you to check on us? Not surprised--he worries too much.
rows.quest:658:details:1: We've been watching the farm for days, and Kin claims she saw a courier come out of that small house to the south not long ago.
rows.quest:658:details:2: She talks a lot, but I can always trust her senses when we're in dangerous areas.
rows.quest:658:details:3: You wouldn't happen to be a skilled tracker, would you? We think the courier might be carrying notes to Tarren Mill. If we could get our hands on those documents, it might shed some light on what's happening in Hillsbrad.
rows.quest:658:progress:0: We appreciate your help in looking for that courier, ⟦16⟧.⟦17⟧⟦18⟧While you were gone, Kin saw an apothecary come out of that same house to the south of here. I'm confident that they're up to no good--I just need proof of it before we go off and do something rash.⟦19⟧⟦20⟧Have you had any luck yet?
rows.quest:658:completion:1: Let's see what this is about...
rows.quest:660:details:0: All right, ⟦21⟧. I'm ready if you are.
rows.quest:660:progress:0: The time for talk is done. Protect ⟦E15⟧ if you care about the people of Hillsbrad at all.
rows.quest:660:completion:0: You've done a great service for us, ⟦22⟧. Thank you.
rows.quest:660:completion:1: I hope Kin wasn't too much of a handful down there. She's very friendly, but can be just as deadly when you're her enemy.
rows.quest:661:details:0: I've seen ⟦E15⟧ look way worse after a night in the tavern than she does now. You obviously did a good job protecting her.
rows.quest:661:details:1: These items she brought back from the farm should at least let Phin get an idea of what's going on out here in Arathi. Just to make sure there's no retaliation after your attack, we're going to stay here for a bit longer. Would you be willing to head back to ⟦E6⟧ and talk to Phin?
rows.quest:661:completion:0: So, the two troublemakers are all right after all? Haha, I'm glad to hear it. I thank you for bringing me news of their whereabouts and status--it pleases me greatly that they are still alive; the two of them are irreplaceable as friends and traveling companions.
rows.quest:661:completion:1: But... it's more important I thank you properly for your help. Here. Take this along with my group's thanks.
rows.quest:661:completion:2: With any luck, we'll figure out what the ⟦E1⟧ are up to, and put an end to it.
rows.quest:518:obj:0: Kill 10 Crushridge Maulers for ⟦E28⟧ in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:518:details:0: Mug'Thol and his Crushridge ogres have overrun the ruins of Alterac. It will be hard to inflict any serious punishment upon him without thinning out the ogres' numbers.
rows.quest:518:details:1: After softening them up, we'll proceed.
rows.quest:518:progress:0: I note that your task is unfinished, ⟦23⟧. Shall I inform ⟦E51⟧ of your ineptitude?
rows.quest:518:completion:0: The snow blooms red with the blood of the ogres, but we cannot cease our efforts until the spirit and numbers of the Crushridge have been crushed and ground into the dirt and snow.
rows.quest:508:obj:0: Return Taretha's pendant to ⟦E30⟧ in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:508:details:0: The pendant? Of course you can have it... Take it! I want no memory of him... just please, please leave in peace...
rows.quest:508:completion:0: It is strange that the Warchief would expend so much over such a small thing. I do not claim to understand him, but I will follow him, whatever his commands. You did well, ⟦25⟧, no doubt the Warchief will be glad to hear of your success.
rows.quest:566:obj:0: Kill ⟦E52⟧ and deliver his head to ⟦E53⟧ in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:566:details:0: By order of ⟦E53⟧, the human known as ⟦E52⟧ is wanted for crimes against the ⟦E1⟧. Vardus is known to be a high-ranking member of the organization known as the ⟦E31⟧.
rows.quest:566:details:1: He was last spotted in the Uplands in the ⟦E43⟧, north of Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:566:details:2: He is wanted dead. Bring evidence of his demise to ⟦E53⟧ to claim the reward.
rows.quest:566:progress:0: Ah, ⟦26⟧. Perhaps you've come to collect the bounty on the head of ⟦E52⟧?
rows.quest:566:completion:0: Productive work you do, ⟦27⟧. With ⟦E52⟧ dead, the number of ⟦E31⟧ leaders grows smaller. Their resistance and irritation will be short-lived.
rows.quest:519:obj:0: Kill ⟦E55⟧, Muckrake, and Glommus and bring their heads to ⟦E28⟧ in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:519:details:0: ⟦E55⟧, Muckrake, and Glommus are Mug'Thol's lieutenants. They are loyal to him, though who can say what drives an ogre to loyalty.
rows.quest:519:details:1: Bring me their heads, ⟦28⟧, and then all that will remain is to remove Mug'Thol's head, crown and all.
rows.quest:519:progress:0: I want their heads, ⟦29⟧, not excuses.
rows.quest:519:completion:0: ...and I thought ogres smelled foul enough to begin with.
rows.quest:519:completion:1: When you bring me Mug'Thol's head, I will have the four of them mounted on pikes above Alterac. A fitting monument to those who go against the Dark Lady's wishes.
rows.quest:507:obj:0: Kill ⟦E56⟧ and ask his mistress, ⟦E45⟧, about Taretha's pendant.
rows.quest:507:details:0: It is clear that Perenolde must be killed, his foulness removed from the world. His manor lies a ways to the north of here, on the shores of Lordamere Lake. Do your duty, ⟦30⟧, then retrieve the pendant that the Warchief desires, and return here.
rows.quest:507:completion:0: No, no please don't hurt me! I never meant your people any harm, he's had me against my will! Please... spare me!
rows.quest:520:obj:0: Kill Mug'Thol, and return his head with the ⟦E57⟧ to ⟦E28⟧ in Tarren Mill.
rows.quest:520:details:0: With Mug'Thol's lieutenants dead, all that remains is to kill Mug'Thol and retrieve the ⟦E57⟧. I have no doubt he'll be reluctant to part with it. Most likely expecting you, too, given the... departure... of his fellows.
rows.quest:520:details:1: Find Mug'Thol, and deliver his head and the Crown to me. The Crushridge resistance will be at an end.
rows.quest:520:progress:0: Three heads I have, a fourth I need. It will be Mug'Thol's, or it will be yours, ⟦31⟧. That I promise.
rows.quest:520:completion:0: You have done your duty well, ⟦32⟧. Mug'Thol's head shall adorn the highest peak of the ruins of Alterac, and the Deathguard will sweep the remnants of the Crushridge into the ground.
rows.quest:521:details:0: All that remains is to deliver the ⟦E57⟧ to ⟦E51⟧ in the ⟦E2⟧. She will see that it is delivered to Lady Sylvanas. I would warn you against thinking to use it for your own purposes, ⟦33⟧, Mug'Thol's fate should be illustration enough.
rows.quest:521:progress:0: I note that your task is unfinished, ⟦34⟧. Shall I inform ⟦E51⟧ of your ineptitude?
rows.quest:521:completion:0: So this is the relic the ogre used to duck the will of the Dark Lady...
rows.quest:521:completion:1: Strange that something so simple could wield so great a power. And to fall into as clumsy hands as those. Well done, ⟦35⟧, I will deliver the crown to Lady Sylvanas, and see that she hears of your accomplishment.

quest:566.turner: High Executor Darthalia («مأمور اجرای عالی دارتالیا»)
